name: User Research Interview
description: Structured notes for customer discovery, usability testing, and user research interviews.

sections.title: Session Metadata
sections.instruction: Date, participant code or persona, interviewer, observer, study name, and consent status

sections.title: Participant Context
sections.instruction: Summarize role, goals, environment, experience level, and relevant background shared by the participant

sections.title: Research Objectives
sections.instruction: List the research questions or hypotheses explored during the interview

sections.title: Key Observations
sections.instruction: Capture behavioral observations, notable quotes, pain points, workarounds, and moments of confusion

sections.title: Needs & Motivations
sections.instruction: Summarize user needs, motivations, goals, jobs to be done, and success criteria

sections.title: Usability Issues
sections.instruction: List usability problems, affected task, impact, and suggested follow-up

sections.title: Insights & Follow-ups
sections.instruction: Summarize insights, open questions, and recommended follow-up research or product actions
